verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU. It does not store or process user data as a service, so user-controlled data retention and deletion is not a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability; the pack covers overclocking, cache, socket support and performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
